ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Assetbundle
ContainedObjects.Description:
Set physics to "Full"!

Controls:
8 = move forwards, kickflip
5 = ollie, kickflip
4= turn left, shoveit
6= turn right, shoveit
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- push defines the amount of forward force
push=2.5
-- maxspeed defines maximum speed
maxspeed=15
--steer defines the angle of steering
steer=2.5
--pop defines the angle at which the skateboard is popped for ollies
pop=60
--ollie defines the amount of ollie
ollie=12.5
--level defines the angle of board leveling
level=5
--kickflip defines the amount of kickflip torque
kickflip=1
--shoveit defines the amount of shoveit torque
shoveit=5
--defines values to avoid scripting errors
yaw=0
left=false
right=false
up=false
down=false
function onPickUp(player_color)
  -- tints the skateboard the color of the player
  self.setColorTint(Color.fromString(player_color))
  -- defines the player as the skater, who controls the skateboard
  skater=(player_color)
  --maintains Y rotation as yaw to avoid false bails
  yaw=self.getRotation().y
end
function onDrop(player_color)
  -- tints the skateboard the color of the player
  self.setColorTint(Color.fromString(player_color))
  -- defines the player as the skater, who controls the skateboard
  skater=(player_color)
  --maintains Y rotation as yaw to avoid false bails
  yaw=self.getRotation().y
end
function onCollisionStay()
  --determines if the skateboard landed forwards
  if yaw<self.getRotation().y+90 and yaw>self.getRotation().y-90
  or yaw>self.getRotation().y+270 or yaw<self.getRotation().y-270
  then ground=true
    --defines speed
    speed = math.sqrt((math.abs(self.getVelocity().x^2))+
    (math.abs(self.getVelocity().z^2)))
    --maintains Y rotation as yaw to avoid false bails
    yaw=self.getRotation().y
    --Corrects the forward direction of the board after a shoveit
  elseif ground==false then ground=true
    self.setRotation({
      x=-self.getRotation().x,
      y=self.getRotation().y+180,
      z=-self.getRotation().z, })
      --if the board is tilted left on the ground
    elseif ground==true and self.getRotation().z>270
      and self.getRotation().z<360-level then
        --level the board
        self.setRotation({
          x=self.getRotation().x,
          y=self.getRotation().y,
          z=self.getRotation().z+level, })
          --if the board is tilted right on the ground
        elseif ground==true and self.getRotation().z<90
          and self.getRotation().z>level then
            --level the board
            self.setRotation({
              x=self.getRotation().x,
              y=self.getRotation().y,
              z=self.getRotation().z-level, })
              --if the board is very close to level, force it to be level
            elseif ground==true
              then self.setRotation({
                x=self.getRotation().x,
                y=self.getRotation().y,
                z=0, })
              end
              function onFixedUpdate()
                --defines speed
                speed = math.sqrt((math.abs(self.getVelocity().x^2))+
                (math.abs(self.getVelocity().z^2)))
                --if the board is pointed up in the air
                if ground==false and self.getRotation().x>270
                and self.getRotation().x<360-level then
                  --level the board
                  self.setRotation({
                    x=self.getRotation().x+level,
                    y=self.getRotation().y,
                    z=self.getRotation().z, })
                    --if the board is pointed down in the air
                  elseif ground==false and self.getRotation().x<90
                    and self.getRotation().x>level then
                      --level the board
                      self.setRotation({
                        x=self.getRotation().x-level,
                        y=self.getRotation().y,
                        z=self.getRotation().z, })
                        --if the board is very close to level, force it to be level
                      elseif ground==false
                        then self.setRotation({
                          x=0,
                          y=self.getRotation().y,
                          z=self.getRotation().z, })
                          --while up is held on the ground and down is not
                        elseif up==true and down==false and ground==true
                          -- if moving below max speed add forward force
                          and speed<maxspeed
                          then self.addForce({
                            x = self.getTransformForward().x * push,
                            y = self.getTransformForward().y * push,
                            z = self.getTransformForward().z * push, })
                            -- when steering left
                          elseif ground==true and left==true and right==false then
                            --add counterclockwise rotation to steer
                            self.setRotation({self.getRotation().x,self.getRotation().y-steer,0})
                            -- when steering right
                          elseif ground==true and right==true and left==false
                            -- add clockwise rotation to steer
                            then self.setRotation({self.getRotation().x,self.getRotation().y+steer,0})
                            end
                          end
                          function onCollisionExit()
                            --determines if the skateboard is not touching the ground
                            ground=false
                            --remembers yaw for shoveits and bails
                            yaw=self.getRotation().y
                            --Stabalize rotation
                            self.setAngularVelocity({0,0,0})
                          end
                          function onScriptingButtonDown(index, player_color)
                            --When Numpad 8 is pressed with skateboard on ground
                            if ground==true and index==8 and player_color==skater then
                              -- adds forward push to the skateboard for forward movement
                              up=true
                              --when numpad 5 is pressed with skateboard on ground
                              --and not steering
                            elseif ground==true and left==false and right==false
                              and index==5 and player_color==skater
                              --tilt the skateboard upwards for an ollie.
                              then self.setRotation({
                                x = -pop,
                                y = self.getRotation().y,
                                z = 0,} )
                                --moves the skateboard upwards to avoid collision problems
                                self.setPosition({
                                  self.getPosition().x,
                                  self.getPosition().y+1,
                                  self.getPosition().z,})
                                  -- adds forward push to the skateboard for ollies
                                  self.addForce({
                                    x = self.getTransformForward().x * ollie,
                                    y = self.getTransformForward().y * ollie,
                                    z = self.getTransformForward().z * ollie, })
                                    down=true
                                    --when numpad 4 is pressed send signal to steer left
                                  elseif ground==true and index==4 and player_color==skater then left=true
                                    --when numpad 6 is pressed send signal to steer right
                                  elseif ground==true and index==6 and player_color==skater then right=true
                                    -- when numpad 4 is pressed with the skateboard off the ground
                                  elseif ground==false and index==4 and player_color==skater
                                    -- add counterclockwise yaw torque to shoveit
                                    then self.addTorque({
                                      x = self.getTransformUp().x * -shoveit,
                                      y = self.getTransformUp().y * -shoveit,
                                      z = self.getTransformUp().z * -shoveit, } )
                                      -- when numpad 6 is pressed with the skateboard off the ground
                                    elseif ground==false and index==6 and player_color==skater
                                      -- add clockwise yaw torque to shoveit
                                      then self.addTorque({
                                        x = self.getTransformUp().x * shoveit,
                                        y = self.getTransformUp().y * shoveit,
                                        z = self.getTransformUp().z * shoveit, } )
                                        -- when numpad 5 is pressed with the skateboard off the ground
                                      elseif ground==false and index==5 and player_color==skater
                                        -- add counterclockwise roll torque to kickflip if in air
                                        then self.addTorque({
                                          x = self.getTransformForward().x * -kickflip,
                                          y = self.getTransformForward().y * -kickflip,
                                          z = self.getTransformForward().z * -kickflip, } )
                                          --when numpad 8 is pressed with the skateboard off the ground
                                        elseif ground==false and index==8 and player_color==skater
                                          -- add counterclockwise roll torque to kickflip
                                          then self.addTorque({
                                            x = self.getTransformForward().x * kickflip,
                                            y = self.getTransformForward().y * kickflip,
                                            z = self.getTransformForward().z * kickflip, } )
                                          end
                                        end
                                      end
                                      function onScriptingButtonUp(index, player_color)
                                        --stops steering and moving forward on button release
                                        if index==4 and player_color==skater then left=false
                                        elseif index==6 and player_color==skater then right=false
                                        elseif index==8 and player_color==skater then up=false
                                        elseif index==5 and player_color==skater then down=false
                                        end
                                      end
